about: compiler/lint: self-hosted DoD linter invariants across tables, strict JSON, config layering, filecase, file index, metrics, CSR graph, graph layout, policy, comments, suppressions, AST shapes, and semantic checks.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-byte-mask-lookup
mutants.rule: ByteMask consults the compile-time ASCII byte-class table for every byte.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-node-idx-mask
mutants.rule: NodeIdxMask maps syntax node kinds to FileIndex collection bits.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-strict-json-dup-key
mutants.from:
case option.Some:
			return BadConfig{Message: "key \(strconv.Quote(key)) is stated twice"}
mutants.rule: Strict JSON parsing refuses objects that repeat a key.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-config-dup-preset
mutants.from:
case option.Some:
			return BadConfig{Message: "preset \(layerName) is applied twice"}
mutants.rule: Configuration rejects applying the same preset layer twice.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-filecase-acronym-split
mutants.rule: Acronyms followed by camel-case words split before the final uppercase letter.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-filecase-kind-suffix
mutants.rule: A file whose entire stem equals a concept word without a separator prefix is not flagged as a kind suffix.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-index-derived-where-testfile
mutants.rule: A non-record refined type declaration generates a top-level refinement law so TestFile matches refined syntax.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-metrics-nesting-cognitive
mutants.rule: An initial if statement adds nesting depth to its cognitive complexity.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-graph-csr-bounds
mutants.rule: EdgeAtStart stores cumulative CSR bounds matching total positioned edges across files.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-layout-long-file
mutants.rule: CheckLongFile emits L165 only when a file exceeds MaxFileLines.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-policy-strict-warning
mutants.rule: PolicyPassed in strict mode rejects runs containing warning findings.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-comments-non-doc
mutants.rule: CheckCommentedCode inspects non-doc comments rather than attached doc comments.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-run-suppression-kept
mutants.rule: applySuppressions omits findings covered by a matching suppression directive.

mutants.name: lint-selfhost-shape-identical-arms
mutants.rule: checkSwitchIdenticalArms inspects switches with two or more arms.
